steps.name: 실시간 연결 - 밖의 저장이 폴링 없이 곧 반영(이 동안 /api/version 호출 1번 이하)
steps.js: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const before=performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>/\/api\/version\//.test(e.name)).length; const t0=Date.now(); { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/grptest',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); d.slides[0].elements.find(x=>x.id==='e02').fill='tertiary-container'; await fetch('/api/deck/grptest?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'zz-other'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); } for (let i=0;i<50 && !((document.querySelector('#toast.show')||document.querySelector('#notice.show')) && /다시 불러왔/.test((document.querySelector('#notice.show #noticeMsg')||document.querySelector('#toast')).textContent));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const dt=Date.now()-t0; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); const calls=performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>/\/api\/version\//.test(e.name)).length-before; return dt<1800 && calls<=1 ? true : JSON.stringify({dt, calls});

steps.name: 함께 보는 사람 - 다른 창이 e01 을 고르면 색 테두리·이름표·머리줄 칩
steps.js: await fetch('/api/presence/grptest',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"tab":"zz-other","where":{"slide":"s1","els":["e01"]},"user":"홍길동"})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !(document.querySelector('#marks .pres') && document.querySelector('#liveChip:not([hidden])'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const nm=document.querySelector('#marks .presnm')?.textContent||''; const chip=document.querySelector('#liveChip')?.textContent||''; return !!document.querySelector('#marks .pres') && nm.includes('홍길동') && chip.includes('함께 1') ? true : JSON.stringify({nm, chip});

steps.name: 그 창이 나가면 테두리·칩이 사라진다
steps.js: await fetch('/api/presence/grptest',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"tab":"zz-other","where":{},"user":"홍길동","leave":true})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !(!document.querySelector('#marks .pres') && document.querySelector('#liveChip[hidden]'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return !document.querySelector('#marks .pres') && !!document.querySelector('#liveChip[hidden]');

steps.name: AI 처리 중 - working 요청의 대상 요소에 '… 처리 중'
steps.js: const l=await (await fetch('/api/requests/grptest',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"action":"add","status":"open","text":"실시간 시험","slide":"s1","element":"e01"})})).json(); const q=l[l.length-1]; await fetch('/api/requests/grptest',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'update',id:q.id,status:'working'})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !(document.querySelector('#marks .presnm.ai'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const t=document.querySelector('#marks .presnm.ai')?.textContent||''; { const l=await (await fetch('/api/requests/grptest')).json(); for (const q of l.filter(x=>x.text==='실시간 시험')) await fetch('/api/requests/grptest',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id:q.id})}); } return t.includes('처리 중') ? true : 'tag='+t;

steps.name: 시트 - 다른 창이 B2:C3 을 고르면 그 범위에 색 테두리·이름
steps.js: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); await fetch('/api/presence/zsheetfill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"tab":"zz-other","where":{"tab":"t01","range":"B2:C3"},"user":"김영희"})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !(document.querySelector('#marks .presBox'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const t=document.querySelector('#marks .presTag')?.textContent||''; const chip=document.querySelector('#liveChip')?.textContent||''; await fetch('/api/presence/zsheetfill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"tab":"zz-other","where":{},"user":"김영희","leave":true})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !(!document.querySelector('#marks .presBox'));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return t.includes('김영희') && chip.includes('함께 1') && !document.querySelector('#marks .presBox') ? true : JSON.stringify({t, chip});

steps.name: 시트 - AI 처리 중 범위 태그
steps.js: const l=await (await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetfill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"action":"add","status":"open","text":"실시간 시험","slide":"t01","range":"A1:B2"})})).json(); const q=l[l.length-1]; await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetfill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'update',id:q.id,status:'working'})}); for (let i=0;i<50 && !([...document.querySelectorAll('#marks .reqTag')].some(x=>x.textContent.includes('처리 중')));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const ok=[...document.querySelectorAll('#marks .reqTag')].some(x=>/AI 처리 중|Claude 처리 중|Codex 처리 중/.test(x.textContent)); { const l=await (await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetfill')).json(); for (const q of l.filter(x=>x.text==='실시간 시험')) await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetfill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id:q.id})}); } return ok;
